text:
## PART 1: Daily Branch Operations  
### Opening Procedures (09:00 AM)  
**30 Minutes Before Opening:**  
1. **Physical Security**
- [ ] Check entrance/exit doors locked
- [ ] Disarm alarm system (code: [SECURITY CODE])
- [ ] Check for any signs of break-in
- [ ] Turn on lights and CCTV  
2. **Cash Handling**
- [ ] Count cash in vault (report to manager)
- [ ] Verify amount matches overnight report
- [ ] Load cash drawers for tellers (standard: £5,000 per drawer)
- [ ] Record drawer assignments
- [ ] Lock vault  
3. **System Startup**
- [ ] Boot up computers
- [ ] Wait for systems to come online
- [ ] Check system status dashboard (green = ready)
- [ ] Log into teller systems with credentials
- [ ] Verify ability to access customer accounts  
4. **Branch Readiness**
- [ ] Check waiting area (seating, magazines, temperature)
- [ ] Verify reception area is clean
- [ ] Check bathrooms are clean and stocked
- [ ] Verify appointment calendar is loaded
- [ ] Confirm staff are at their desks by 08:50 AM  
**9:00 AM - Ready for Customers**

raw_entities.name: Daily Branch Opening Procedures
raw_entities.description: A procedural training module covering the daily opening sequence for branch staff, executed 30 minutes before customer service begins at 09:00 AM. The module encompasses physical security checks, cash handling and vault procedures, system startup verification, and branch readiness confirmation. Staff must complete all four procedural sections in sequence before the branch opens to customers.

raw_entities.name: Physical Security Check Execution
raw_entities.description: Staff must be able to execute physical security checks including verifying entrance/exit doors are locked, disarming the alarm system, checking for signs of break-in, and activating lights and CCTV systems.
context: Check for any signs of break-in

raw_entities.name: Cash Handling and Vault Verification
raw_entities.description: Staff must be able to count cash in the vault, verify amounts against overnight reports, load cash drawers to the standard amount, record drawer assignments, and secure the vault.
context: Count cash in vault (report to manager)
Load cash drawers for tellers (standard: £5,000 per drawer)

raw_entities.name: Banking System Startup and Access Verification
raw_entities.description: Staff must be able to boot up computers, wait for systems to come online, check the system status dashboard for readiness indicators, log into teller systems with credentials, and verify access to customer accounts.
context: Log into teller systems with credentials
Verify ability to access customer accounts

raw_entities.name: Branch Facility and Staff Readiness Confirmation
raw_entities.description: Staff must be able to verify the waiting area is suitable for customers, confirm reception and bathroom cleanliness and stocking, load the appointment calendar, and ensure all staff are at their desks by 08:50 AM.
context: Check bathrooms are clean and stocked
Confirm staff are at their desks by 08:50 AM

raw_entities.name: Cash Drawer Loading and Recording
raw_entities.description: Staff must load cash drawers for tellers to the standard amount of £5,000 per drawer and record all drawer assignments as part of the opening procedure.
context: Load cash drawers for tellers (standard: £5,000 per drawer)

raw_entities.name: Vault Cash Count and Manager Reporting
raw_entities.description: Staff must count the cash in the vault and report the amount to the manager, then verify it matches the overnight report before proceeding with drawer loading.
context: Count cash in vault (report to manager)

raw_entities.name: System Status Verification Before Customer Access
raw_entities.description: Staff must verify that the system status dashboard shows green (ready status) and confirm the ability to access customer accounts before the branch opens to customers.
context: Verify ability to access customer accounts
